name: seo-audit
title: SEO Audit
description: Crawl a site’s whole sitemap and check every page for the SEO, metadata and structured-data problems single-URL graders miss.
author: nurkamol

commands.name: preview
commands.title: Preview Site
commands.description: How big is this site, and is it the right one — three requests, about a second.

commands.name: audit
commands.title: Audit Site
commands.description: Crawl a site and list what to change, worst first.

commands.name: reports
commands.title: Recent Reports
commands.description: Runs kept by the macOS app and by this extension.

preferences.name: limit
preferences.title: Pages per run
preferences.description: A launcher is a poor place to wait out a crawl of a thousand pages. Big sites belong in the app or the terminal.

preferences.name: speed
preferences.title: Speed
preferences.description: Gentle is one connection at a time — the setting that gets through a site answering HTTP 429.

preferences.name: checkExternal
preferences.title: Outbound links
preferences.label: Check that links to other sites still resolve
preferences.description: Slower, and only a 404, 410 or no answer is reported.

preferences.name: sitemap
preferences.title: Sitemap
preferences.description: Only when a sitemap is somewhere the usual names do not find it. It has to be on the site being audited.

preferences.name: exclude
preferences.title: Exclude
preferences.description: URL patterns to keep out of the crawl, one per line or comma separated. * stops at a slash, ** does not. What is skipped is always reported.

preferences.name: since
preferences.title: Only what changed since
preferences.description: A date. Crawls only URLs the sitemap says changed on or after it. Refuses, and checks everything, when lastmod cannot answer.

preferences.name: browser
preferences.title: Identify as
preferences.description: Some sites answer a crawler differently from a browser.

preferences.name: os
preferences.title: On
preferences.description: A combination that cannot exist — Safari on Windows — is refused by the engine and the run goes ahead as itself.

preferences.name: userAgent
preferences.title: Or a user agent of your own
preferences.description: Wins over the two menus above. Bounded and stripped of control characters, because it ends up in a request header.

preferences.name: performance
preferences.title: Performance
preferences.description: Google measures it in a real browser over its own network. This never estimates it. Each page is a few seconds, which is why it is sampled.

preferences.name: performanceSample
preferences.title: Pages to measure
preferences.description: When Performance is set to a sample. Spread across the site rather than the first few.

preferences.name: performanceDesktop
preferences.title: Desktop
preferences.label: Measure as a desktop browser
preferences.description: Mobile otherwise, which is what Google indexes with.

preferences.name: ignore
preferences.title: Silenced checks
preferences.description: Check ids to leave out, comma separated. Copy one from any finding with ⌘. — a report still says how many were silenced.
